question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 4
solution:
The correct answer is '**looks**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence describes the transformation of the savanna during the wet season, highlighting how it appears beautiful.
 
• The verb should indicate a change in appearance rather than an action like studying or examining.
 
• "**Looks**" fits naturally, as it means "appears" or "seems," which aligns with the context of describing the savanna’s beauty.
 
• Other options ("**gapes**", "**studies**", "**examines**") do not fit well in the sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 4**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Gapes (मुंह खुला रखना): "Gapes" means to stare with one's mouth open wide, which does not fit the context of inspecting or observing closely.
 
• Studies (अध्ययन करता है): "Studies" means to devote time and attention to acquiring knowledge on an academic subject, which is too formal for the context.
 
• Examines (जांच करता है): "Examines" means to inspect closely, which is a good fit but "looks" is more natural and commonly used in this context.
